description: This file defines the TraceModel class and related interfaces for handling trace data, including loading trace entries, processing resources, and managing context entries within a trace viewer application.

classes.name: TraceModel
classes.description: Main class for managing trace data, loading trace entries, and providing access to resources and context entries.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads trace data from a backend, processes trace files, and populates context entries.

methods.name: hasEntry
methods.description: Checks if a specific trace entry exists in the backend.

methods.name: resourceForSha1
methods.description: Retrieves a resource blob by its SHA-1 hash, returning a Blob with appropriate content type if available.

methods.name: storage
methods.description: Returns the SnapshotStorage instance associated with this trace model.
